title: Monotonicity of Gap Promises
statement: Let $P$ be an encoded maximization problem, and let $s<c$ and $s'<c'$ be real thresholds with $s\le s'$ and $c'\le c$. The promise problem whose yes instances are valid inputs with optimum at least $c$ and whose no instances are valid inputs with optimum at most $s$ is polynomial-time Karp reducible to the corresponding promise problem with thresholds $s'$ and $c'$.
